mainEntity.name: How do I choose a company for ongoing restoration maintenance?

acceptedAnswer.text: When choosing a company for ongoing restoration maintenance, consider their experience, certifications, and reputation. Look for a company that offers comprehensive services tailored to your property's specific needs after restoration. Read reviews, ask for references, and ensure they are licensed and insured in your area. A reliable company will provide clear communication and detailed service agreements.
